documented_search_rules.negative_exact: Base query must contain the same ordered terms without additional words; published automatic case and misspelling handling also applies.
documented_search_rules.case_and_misspellings: Google documents automatic handling; this does not disclose its matching algorithm or prove the local matcher reproduces it.
documented_search_rules.synonyms_and_number_variants: Published guidance requires separate synonym and singular/plural exclusions when desired; none are generated here.
documented_search_rules.account_level: An account-level list can affect eligible Search and Shopping inventory globally; that scope is not adopted.

local_matching_assurance.matcher: Existing frozen lexical approximation; no code change.

application_policy.scope: Saved Buyers campaign only for separately reviewed held EXACT proposals. No account-wide list or inferred ad-group ownership.

capture_provenance.hash_scope: UTF8 JSON-encoded complete native web-tool text representation, not original Google HTTP bytes; retained privately.
